title: chore(typescript): setup Rollup and Babel builds (part 4)
body:
This is the fourth step toward our process migrating to TypeScript.

- **Rollup**.
  - Allow the UMD build to accept many extensions, including `ts` and `tsx` (others are for imported modules).
- **CJS and ES**.
  - Allow Babel to compile `ts` and `tsx` files.
  - Update pattern matching for test and mock files to be correctly ignored with Babel 7.
- **Types**.
  - Add React and Lodash types for migrating our codebase later.
